verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a SaaS scraping API that offers AI features such as ai_query, AI extraction, and ChatGPT/Gemini proxy APIs, so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training data policy, opt-out control, or data-retention commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
